title: 第9章 两位互相认识吗第10章 他们打起来了
slug: 人在废丹房我以丹药证道成仙
content_zh:
只见碎冰冰状态的飞剑，泛起金色的光芒，以肉眼可见的速度相互拼接在一起。
最后随着一阵白光闪过，破碎的青色飞剑，竟如崭新出厂般躺在床上。
古青色的剑身上，散发着超乎寻常的凌厉气息。
“成了！”
叶云眼前一亮，连忙将之拿起，玄阶飞剑啊，这可是他以前想都不敢想法宝！
以至于，叶云都迫不及待地将之认主。
他当即割破手指，将鲜血染在剑身之上，飞剑也很快吸收，并绽放出青色的光芒！
如此一来，这把青霄剑就正式属于他了！
“也不知道，这玄阶法宝的威力如何……”
心痒难耐的叶云，干脆悄悄润出废丹房，在圣地找了一处无人的树林。
在四下观察一番，确定没人偷看后，叶云这才取出青霄剑，凝望着面前一棵需要两三人合抱的大树。
随着叶云将玄气灌入剑身，青霄剑上迸发出青色剑光。
“给我开！”
叶云眼中精光一闪，手中的青霄剑也随之斩出，在面前划出一道优美的青色剑光。
片刻过后，林间传来一阵轰隆声，一时之间鸟兽尽散。
而在烟尘散去，叶云看着面前倒下的粗壮大树，以及树干上的整齐切口，嘴巴都张大了几分。
“我去，不愧是玄阶法宝，这锋利度当真夸张！”
换做是寻常凡阶法宝，恐怕都未必能一剑砍断，更别说这般轻而易举的切开。
看着手中的青霄剑，叶云眼中满是狂喜。
“接下来，就该找一部御剑之术了。”

虽说作为手中剑来用，这就已经很不错。
但青霄剑作为飞剑法宝，想要施展出最大威力，终归需要以御剑之术驱使才行。
只是这个，就需要等去坊市中碰碰运气，说不定就有弟子售卖。
转眼间，两天时间过去。
今天就是与人约定的日子，也该去云岚坊市，见见那位受伤的内门师姐。
在出发之前，他特地在废丹房中，找了一炉圣火丹的废丹。
作为泛用性极窄的四品丹药，圣火丹的废丹都不多，可见想找一颗成品丹药有多难。
带上圣火丹的废丹，叶云便直接前往云岚坊市，并找到上次立下约定的店铺。
见到叶云出现，灵烟眼前一亮叫道。
“你这家伙可算来了，我还以为你跑路了呢！”
“着什么急，这不是来了吗。”
叶云四下看了眼问道：“倒是你口中，那位内门师姐呢？”
灵烟也没废话，对他招了招手道。
“跟我来，师姐正在住处修养呢。”
叶云点点头，便跟着她一同离开云岚坊市，直奔圣地一处偏僻的山峰之上。
content_en:
I saw the flying swords in the state of shattered ice, glowing with golden light, splicing together at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Finally, with a flash of white light, the broken green flying sword lay on the bed as if it was brand new from the factory.
The ancient green sword exudes an unusually sharp aura.
"It's done!"
Ye Yun's eyes lit up and he quickly picked it up. The Xuanjie Flying Sword was a treasure that he had never dared to think of before!
So much so that Ye Yun could not wait to recognize him as his master.
He immediately cut his finger and stained the blood on the sword body. The flying sword quickly absorbed it and burst into cyan light!
In this way, this Qingxiao Sword officially belongs to him!
"I don't know how powerful this mysterious magic weapon is..."
Feeling itchy, Ye Yun quietly left the abandoned elixir room and found an uninhabited forest in the Holy Land.
After looking around to make sure no one was peeking, Ye Yun took out the Qingxiao Sword and stared at a big tree in front of him that needed two or three people to hug it.
As Ye Yun poured profound energy into the sword, green sword light burst out from the Qingxiao sword.
"Open it for me!"
Ye Yun's eyes flashed, and the Qingxiao Sword in his hand was slashed out, drawing a beautiful blue sword light in front of him.
After a while, there was a rumble in the forest, and all the birds and beasts disappeared.
After the smoke and dust dissipated, Ye Yun opened his mouth a bit as he looked at the thick fallen tree in front of him and the neat cuts on the trunk.
"I'll go, it's indeed a Xuan-level magic weapon, its sharpness is really exaggerated!"
If it were an ordinary ordinary magic weapon, it might not be able to cut it off with a sword, let alone cut it open so easily.
Looking at the Qingxiao Sword in his hand, Ye Yun's eyes were filled with ecstasy.
"Next, it's time to find a sword-controlling technique."
Although it is used as a shuriken, it is already very good.
However, Qingxiao Sword is a flying sword magic weapon. If you want to exert its maximum power, you need to use the skill of sword control.
Just for this, you need to go to the market to try your luck, maybe there will be disciples selling it.
In the blink of an eye, two days passed.
Today is the day agreed with someone, and it is time to go to Yunlanfang City to meet the injured inner sect sister.
Before setting off, he went to the waste elixir room to find a furnace of waste elixirs for the holy fire elixir.
As a fourth-grade elixir with extremely narrow general use, there are not many useless elixirs of Holy Fire elixir, which shows how difficult it is to find a finished elixir.
Carrying the waste pill of the Holy Fire Pill, Ye Yun went directly to Yunlanfang City and found the store where he made the last agreement.
Seeing Ye Yun appear, Ling Yan's eyes lit up and he shouted.
"You guys are here, I thought you ran away!"
"What's the rush? Isn't this coming?"
Ye Yun looked around and asked, "Where is the inner sect sister you mentioned?"
Ling Yan didn't waste any time and waved to him.
"Follow me, senior sister is recuperating at her residence."
Ye Yun nodded and followed her out of Yunlanfang City, heading straight to a remote mountain peak in the Holy Land.
